variant.briefing:
Hey,

I’ve been hustling to track down what happened to a bunch of important supplies stolen from a CFP outpost. As I suspected, they were taken by the Headhunters who currently have them stashed at [Location]. 

My source also warned me that they might be moving the supplies to a more secure location soon. Feels like our window of getting them back is closing fast. Can you head over to that outpost and reclaim them before they disappear again?

Clearly, it’s a risky op but I wouldn’t be asking if those supplies weren’t important. Secure them and then bring them to [Destination].

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Be safe out there, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
